Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Kumar Singh,Kamlesh Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.279 of 2020.
under Section 498A, 323, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Gazipur, District Lucknow.
3. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 22.07.2021.

1 4.

In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant in the year 2014 who used to harass her on account of dowry and subsequently, on 24.04.2020, the daughter had committed suicide by hanging.

In the light of the said allegation, learned counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the post-mortem report which indicates a ligature mark on the neck and a contusion on the back of the head.
The cause of death is shown as Asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant also draws my attention to a suicide note left by the deceased wherein several allegations were levelled in the said suicide note by the deceased, however, there is no allegation that soon before her death, she was being subjected to any physical or mental cruelty in relation to demand of dowry.
It is further argued that the mother of the victim has also deposed with regard to the said suicide note.
It was also stated that the house owner would not permit the applicant to enter inside the house on account of prevalent corona situation.
The applicant is in custody since 25.04.2020.
6. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

7. Considering the suicide note and the fact that the cause of death is Asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging, prima-facie, the material to form a view that soon before her death she was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry, is missing.

The applicant has no criminal antecedent and thus, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, can adversely affect the trial, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Shahali Arya alias Shahil Arya alias Mohd. Danish be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
